'''Nari Beksen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked for the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After Corsignis became engaged in a dispute with the [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]] over the control of trade on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pinett]], a group of agents attempted to mediate a resolution to the disagreement and Beksen represented Corsignis during the agents' negotiations.
